description: This file contains the code-behind for the 'SetExam' ASP.NET WebForm page in the OnlineExamSystem project. It includes event handlers for page load, button clicks, dropdown list selections, and database operations related to adding MCQ questions and setting up exams for different courses and semesters.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page handling exam question setup, course selection, and navigation within the OnlineExamSystem.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load event; currently contains commented code for session management.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page when the 'Home' button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page when the 'Profile' button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page when the 'Leaderboard' button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester from the dropdown. Adds appropriate course options dynamically.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears all input text boxes related to question and exam setup.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new multiple-choice question to the database, updates question number based on current count, and displays confirmation. Uses inline SQL with string concatenation.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record for the selected course in the database and returns to the AdminPanel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown options based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number in the text box when a course is selected.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the login page upon logout.
